title: 90s inspired fantasy strategy with modernization (free webgl build)
author: Odd_Cauliflower6672
selftext:
40 old gamer nerd & Unity dev here, leveraging AI coding and art to satisfy the nostalgia feels of awesome old games from my childhood.

My current project is inspired by fantasy strategy games from the 90s and Astra/Fable have both been doing some heavy lifting. It has prettier graphics (maintained 2d for simplicity of animation, but w/modernized level of detail - thanks to imagegen through ChatGPT), tons of QoL improvements, while maintaining that original "feel" of the inspiration. It is currently hosted as a Unity webgl build - free and playable now through your browser. It is still in early stages, albeit fully playable, but expect frequent changes/updates/overhauls. There is plenty of tuning to be worked through, however I encourage you to come check it out! And please feel free to provide your feedback and/or report any bugs that you may come across so I can confirm they get added to the to-do list. There is an early game tutorial built-in to try and explain some basics and help get you started (it can be disabled in the Options menu).

Protip: If running at higher game speeds, be sure to keep an eye on the minimap for incoming reds (mousewheel on minimap will zoom). F11 for fullscreen toggle. RMB works as alternate input for ESC key to close menus and whatnot (since ESC breaks out of fullscreen due to browser safety rules). This info is available in the game Help menus, but just in case you're one of those that won't look ;)

*(anyone who played fantasy strategy games from the 90s should be able to identify the primary inspiration of this one)*

[https://play.frontierkingdoms.com](https://play.frontierkingdoms.com)
